revision_reason: The prior Stage 1 attempts 25469445.pbs101 and 25476081.pbs101 remain FAIL_CLOSED and are preserved unchanged. A pinned-source audit explains the latter's only unequal key: EverythingToInfoWrapper.reset samples an action-space value, then replaces it with np.full_like(..., np.nan); BasePolicy._prepare_info preserves that numeric array as a tensor. The previous torch.equal comparator returns false even when the action NaN masks match. This revision retains action in the paired key set and compares shape/dtype, identical NaN and signed-infinity masks, and exact equality of every finite action value; all other prepared tensors also require matching shape/dtype and torch.equal. No arms, seeds, solver, schedules, estimands, numerical thresholds, sample sizes, or resource limits change. The previous descriptive quality/latency values remain invalid as paired results; rerun Stage 1 to test all gates with the corrected semantic equality rule.
question: 在 official LeWM CEM 求解器中，late_teacher7 是否在保留 student-only 相比的规划质量改善时，减少 teacher 调用并在真实 PushT simulator 闭环中提升成功率？

source.source_validation_scope: These commit IDs identify the upstream revisions used as staging provenance/reference. The remote source directories are staged snapshots without Git metadata; this run verifies imported module roots and runtime APIs, but does not independently attest the snapshot commit IDs.

model.teacher: staged official LeWM PushT checkpoint pusht/lewm_object.ckpt

official_planner.candidate_zero: official CEM solver overwrites candidate 0 with the current mean before scoring
official_planner.elite_update: official torch.topk(cost, k=30, dim=1, largest=False), mean(dim=1), std(dim=1) with PyTorch default unbiased=True
official_planner.solver_modification: none; use pinned CEMSolver.solve unchanged; only cost model get_cost routes between official teacher and frozen student
official_planner.reset_info_action_semantics: EverythingToInfoWrapper.reset samples action_space, then intentionally replaces the sampled action with np.full_like(action, np.nan); the finite sample is therefore not the reset action stored in World.infos. EnvPool stacks this all-NaN action as [env,time,action_dim], and BasePolicy._prepare_info converts it to a tensor without changing values. Seed the concrete action space as before. Keep action in paired checks and require matching shape/dtype, identical NaN/+Inf/-Inf masks, and torch.equal over all finite entries. CEMSolver.prepare_init_action zero-pads because JEPA is not Actionable; JEPA.get_cost removes reset action from goal encoding and rollout replaces info['action'] with candidate actions. reward=np.nan is outside the prepared-key comparison whitelist.
official_planner.final_plan_quality_audit: Apply to all four configured strategy arms and both native/routed fidelity paths. Use the first actual expanded info_dict captured immediately before each path's first solver get_cost call, retain sample index 0 (same repeated observation), and score the final plan as one candidate with shape [B,1,T,10]. Native get_cost capture delegates the same args and return value unchanged. Record prepared-info, CEM action/cost, scorer input and output shapes. Do not re-prepare or re-slice raw world observations for the audit.
official_planner.native_teacher_equivalence: paired solver seeds must produce bitwise-equal candidates, costs, elite indices, elite candidates, mean/variance updates, final plan, and first action for native teacher and routed teacher-only; native get_cost is wrapped only by a read-only input-shape/sample-0 capture that delegates the same args and return value to the original JEPA method

stage1.purpose: fail-closed native official solver semantics, late7 routing, quality and latency gate before any closed-loop run
stage1.reset_action_space_seed: Before each Stage 1 World.reset(seed=s), call world.envs.envs[0].action_space.seed(s) as before. The wrapper then overwrites its finite sample with an all-NaN action placeholder; retain action and compare matching shape/dtype, NaN/+Inf/-Inf masks, and exact equality of every finite entry.
stage1.shared_cem_innovations: For paired reset block index b (0-based), reset the official CEM solver-owned torch_gen to cem_seed_base+b before every execution path; each solve therefore receives the same ordered standard-normal innovations.
stage1.native_equivalence_runs: For each paired seed, separately randomize the order of native_teacher_reference using a capture-only get_cost proxy that forwards unchanged to the original teacher, and routed_teacher_reference through a transparent get_cost router that delegates to the original teacher on every round. Both use the unmodified CEMSolver.solve, identical solver seed, and bitwise-identical policy-preprocessed observation. Both proxies retain the actual first expanded solver info sample for post-timing final-plan cost audit; full tensor references are retained only for the paired fidelity traces and compared after solver timing.
stage1.quality_estimand: Per reset seed: (official_teacher_cost(final_late_teacher7_plan) - official_teacher_cost(final_student_plan)) divided by the population standard deviation of the native teacher round-1 candidate costs; negative favors late_teacher7.
stage1.latency_estimand: CUDA-synchronized full CEMSolver.solve walltime per paired fixed observation, including official candidate generation, scorer, top-k and distribution update; no environment step is inside this Stage 1 timer.

gates.native_equivalence: All 8 paired seeds are bitwise equal for every required per-round trace field and final plan/action.
gates.schedule: All 8 late_teacher7 solves use teacher exactly on rounds 24-30 and exactly 7 total calls; uniform7 is exactly rounds 4,8,12,16,20,24,28.
gates.validity: all expected reset seeds and arms complete; strategy-arm per-round costs and mean/variance updates, solver outputs, final actions, audit scores and timings are finite; native/routed fidelity traces check every floating field; initial state, goal, and every policy-prepared observation key pair across paths after paired action-space seeding; all keys require matching shape/dtype and exact torch.equal except reset action, which requires identical NaN and signed-infinity masks plus exact equality of every finite value; no fallback or silent schedule change
gates.overall: PASS only if native equivalence, schedule, quality, latency and validity all pass; otherwise Stage 2 is not run

environment.executor: pinned stable_worldmodel.World and WorldModelPolicy over registered swm/PushT-v1 Gymnasium/Pymunk environment
environment.termination_success: pinned PushT.eval_state: L2 distance of state[:4] from goal_state[:4] < 20 and wrapped block-angle error < pi/9, with shape symmetry; success is World.terminateds, truncation at 50 is not success
environment.task_unit: one independently seeded simulator episode; episode is the paired statistical unit

pairing.same_start_goal: Each arm receives a fresh World, seeds its concrete action_space with the shared task seed, then World.evaluate resets the actual simulator with that same task seed; initial state, goal_state, and all captured policy-prepared keys are required to match within the 4-arm seed block under the frozen semantic equality rule.
pairing.reset_action_space_seed: Before World.evaluate, seed world.envs.envs[0].action_space with task_seed. The wrapper samples a finite action but overwrites the reset info action with an all-NaN placeholder; keep this action key and require matching shape/dtype and identical NaN/+Inf/-Inf masks, with exact finite-value equality. Compare every captured prepared key and persist per-key equality flags.
pairing.arm_order: Randomized within each seed using Python Random(arm_order_seed_base + block_index); persist exact order.
pairing.planner_innovations: Pinned CEMSolver owns self.torch_gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed), and solve calls torch.randn(..., generator=self.torch_gen). For each task seed and CEM call index, reseed this solver-owned generator to solver_seed_base + 4*block_index + call_index. All arms share identical standard-normal candidate innovations at matching call indices. Candidate distributions and observations can diverge as a treatment effect.
pairing.limitations: Common random numbers are exact for paired CEM call indices; arms that terminate at different steps naturally execute different numbers of calls. Resets are paired by pinned simulator and action-space seeds and verified state/goal/prepared observations, not by HDF5 rows.

sample_size.basis: The pinned LeWM PushT evaluation configuration defaults to num_eval=50; use the full official-sized bounded count rather than a convenience pilot.
sample_size.power_claim: No formal power claim: there is no trustworthy prior paired LeWM closed-loop effect estimate. No extension or optional stopping after viewing results.

stage2.primary_outcome: per-episode binary simulator success before the 50-step time limit
secondary_outcomes: per-step official state distance and positional/angular progress
episode environment steps and terminated/truncated status
CUDA-synchronized total and per-CEM-call planner walltime

decision_gate.late7_practical_benefit_vs_student: at least 5 additional successes out of 50 paired seeds AND two-sided exact McNemar p < 0.05
decision_gate.late7_practical_noninferiority_vs_teache: late_teacher7 success count is no more than 5 below teacher_only out of 50 paired seeds; report as a practical margin, not a powered formal noninferiority claim
decision_gate.overall: PASS only if the complete validity gate passes and both success gates pass; otherwise report FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE according to paired results. Do not extend this frozen run.

stage2.incremental_output: Append and flush one JSONL row after every arm episode, including full per-step progress, so completed observations survive an interrupted bounded job. No automatic resubmission.

resources.telemetry: direct nvidia-smi process writing timestamp, utilization and used/total memory into job.log; trap kills and waits for its PID

external_method_reference: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065. Procedural method context only; not LeWM or PushT evidence.
claim_boundary: Stage 1 is official fixed-observation CEM integration/fidelity evidence. Stage 2, only after Stage 1 PASS, is a 50-seed paired closed-loop comparison in the actual pinned PushT simulator. Neither stage changes the trained checkpoint.
